newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close low, approach key barrier.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close low, approach key barrier.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks continued to weaken on Thursday, closing nearer the 600-point psychological barrier, brokers said.
The Colombo Stock exchange all share index closed 1.3 points down at 606.4. On Wednesday, the index closed 4.19 points down at 607.69, continuing the downward trend of the past week.
An initial public offer (IPO) of the new Lion Brewery Ltd, which opened on the stock exchange on Thursday, was more than 75 percent subscribed by noon on the first day.
Lion Brewery, a subsidiary of Ceylon Brewery Ltd, announced an IPO of 12.5 million 10-rupee shares at 20 rupees.
"(Response to) the IPO shows the type of interest there is in this market," said Tivanka Ratnayake, manager of John Keells Stock Brokers. "It could even slow down the present decline."
Other brokers said high-performing IPOs were good for the market in the long-term, but not for immediate gains.
"When there are good IPOs the market has been slow. People go for the IPO instead, ignoring the market," said Ralph Wijesinghe of Asia Securities.
Turnover, supported mainly by foreign selling of 4.5 million Ceylon Grain Elevators at nine rupees, was 46.6 million rupees.
